title: feat(plugin-security,spec,plugin-auth)!: a delegated admin's write outside their own scope answers 403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XKbZrFQoGL2ugEVaKwGYgBq)_

Fixes #26189

Clause-②: yes (widening: the ADR-0112 ledger registers `DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION` under `@objectstack/plugin-security`)
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: #26059 ruling Q1 是 / Q2 不做 / Q3 分拆 / Q4 框架 (`6416233738`), this card is Q3 child 3; claim `6423979372`

## Summary

When a delegated administrator's write fell outside their own `adminScope`, the delegated-administration gate knew the reason ("business unit … is outside the delegated subtree") but threw it as a plain `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. A client could not tell it from a denial whose reason must stay hidden. Per the ruling, a refusal that describes the caller's own scope now answers its own code; everything else is unchanged.

- **`plugin-security/src/errors.ts`**: new `DelegationScopeViolationError`, status and statusCode `403`, code `DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`. A sibling of `PermissionDeniedError`, not a subclass.
- **`plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts`**: the per-scope checks mark the three scope reasons with `outsideScope(…)`; `firstApprovalFailure` keeps that mark on the reason it surfaces; `refusalFor` picks the class. The message is `[Security] Outside your delegated scope: delegated 'OP' on OBJECT rejected — REASON (scope from 'SET').`
- **Why not `[Security] Access denied`**: that prefix is the `PERMISSION_DENIED` matcher in `mapDataError`, `isPermissionDeniedError` and `rest/src/security-routes.ts`. Kept, it re-flattens the code at the REST door; the ablation below shows exactly that. Same precedent as `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`'s `[Security] Permission set …`.
- **`plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`** (`isInvitationPlacementGateRefusal`): invitation placement dry-runs the same gate, and this predicate recognised its verdict only by `PERMISSION_DENIED`. Without the one-line addition, an invitation placed outside the issuer's scope would answer the `503` read-fault instead of `403 INVITE_PLACEMENT_OUTSIDE_ISSUER_SCOPE` (pinned red-first below).
- **`spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`**: one row under `@objectstack/plugin-security`, appended. It is its own meaning, `standardSynonymOf` answers `undefined`, and no waiver is needed. `#26250`'s `DUPLICATE_MATCH_KEY` row landed first and both are kept (main merged).
- **`content/docs/references/api/*.mdx`**: regenerated by `gen:docs` (the ledger lists), on the merged tree.

### The split, one line per throw site (`delegated-admin-gate.ts` on this head)

| Throw site | Reason | Answer |
|---|---|---|
| `authorize`, anchor invariant | the `everyone` / `guest` audience anchor is implicit | `PERMISSION_DENIED` (unchanged) |
| `authorize`, principal-less | no `userId` | `PERMISSION_DENIED` (unchanged) |
| `authorize`, `sys_member` | organization membership is tenant-only | `PERMISSION_DENIED` (unchanged) |
| `authorize`, organization boundary | organization administrator outside the boundary, no scope held | `PERMISSION_DENIED` (unchanged) |
| `authorize`, plain CRUD | no tenant administration, no `adminScope` | `PERMISSION_DENIED` (unchanged) |
| `authorize`, filter write | a delegate must target single rows by id | `PERMISSION_DENIED` (unchanged) |
| `assertSelfDelegation` `deny` | delegation of duty (ADR-0091 D3), every rule | `PERMISSION_DENIED` (unchanged) |
| `assertAssignmentWrite` | business unit outside the delegated subtree (new row) | **`DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`** |
| `assertAssignmentWrite` | the existing assignment's business unit outside the subtree (pre-image) | **`DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`** |
| `assertAssignmentWrite` | the position distributes a set not in the scope's allowlist | **`DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`** |
| `assertAssignmentWrite` | scope without `manageAssignments`; unanchored row (new or existing); adminScope containment | `PERMISSION_DENIED` (unchanged) |
| `assertDirectGrantWrite` | permission set not in the scope's allowlist | **`DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`** |
| `assertDirectGrantWrite` | target user outside the delegated subtree | **`DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`** |
| `assertDirectGrantWrite` | scope without `manageAssignments`; stored grant whose set is unnamed or not in the catalog; no target user; target user with no business unit; adminScope containment | `PERMISSION_DENIED` (unchanged) |

With several held scopes the gate surfaces the last scope's first reason, as before, and the code follows that reason. `manageAssignments` and containment are read literally against the ruling ("every other refusal keeps `PERMISSION_DENIED`"), though both concern the caller's scope; see Acceptance notes.

No `explain-engine.ts`, no `ui/`. Ruling #24914 B′ is unchanged: the console's `isPermissionError` (`ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts:202`) still treats any `403` as the fixed line until child 4 (#26190) lands.

## Tests

Red first, on the unfixed code (`e05e0de8` + tests):
- `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts` `[#26189]`: 5 scope cells red (`expected [ 'PERMISSION_DENIED', 403, 403 ] to deeply equal [ 'DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION', …(2) ]`), 10 non-scope controls green.
- `auth-manager.test.ts` (scope-violation stand-in): red, `expected 503 to be 403`.
- `error-code-ledger.test.ts` (the new code): red, `ZodError … invalid_value`.

New and changed pins:
- `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts` `[#26189]`: each scope cell asserts `code`, `status`, `statusCode`, the reason, `name`, the message not opening with the matcher prefix, `isPermissionDeniedError` false, and `mapDataError` answering `403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION` with the message. Each non-scope cell asserts `PERMISSION_DENIED` on the throw and through `mapDataError`.
- Door pin, over HTTP (`showcase-permission-zoo.dogfood.test.ts`): the delegate's out-of-subtree `POST /data/sys_user_position` and off-allowlist `POST /data/sys_user_permission_set` now assert `403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION` and the reason (they asserted only "not 2xx"); a control, an unanchored assignment, answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`.
- The dispatcher door: `delegable-scope-no-identity-positions.posture.test.ts` reads `resolveThrownHttpError` and now expects `403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION` for the gate's allowlist refusal.
- Flipped from `PERMISSION_DENIED` (each is an allowlist reason): `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts` own-name CONTROL, `delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` CONTROL (three postures), `delegated-admin-gate-catalog.test.ts`, the posture test above.
- `errors.test.ts`: the new class joins the floor (both status spellings).
- `auth-manager.test.ts`: the scope-violation stand-in answers `403 INVITE_PLACEMENT_OUTSIDE_ISSUER_SCOPE`.
- `error-code-ledger.test.ts`: parses, is listed under plugin-security, `standardSynonymOf` is `undefined`, no waiver.

### Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to `blob == HEAD`)

| Mutation | Proof it reached `dist/` | Result |
|---|---|---|
| The new class's message opens with `[Security] Access denied:` again | `ablation-dist-preflight` exit 0 | `showcase-permission-zoo.dogfood.test.ts`: 2 failed / 9 passed, both door pins (`expected [ 403, 'PERMISSION_DENIED' ] …`); the control stays green |

Restore: `git diff HEAD` empty, plugin-security rebuilt, `--absent` preflight exit 0. A first attempt (a `typeof` swap) failed the DTS build, so it measured nothing and was replaced.

Two needed a container step first: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (fetch of its pinned fixture commit) and `check:type-check-debt` (re-run under the lock after the dogfood run released it); both exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: the one stale artifact (`content/docs/references/**`) regenerated with `--fix`, on the merged tree.

## Acceptance notes

- The claim's `Clause-②: no` was measured as `yes (widening)`: the ledger header says registering a code widens the published face, door or no door. Status and acceptance are unchanged, so it is not narrowing. The changeset carries the **BREAKING** (wire-answer) banner and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker, the shape used for the same class of change before.
- Two refusals concern the caller's scope but stay `PERMISSION_DENIED` under the ruling's literal list: a scope without `manageAssignments`, and adminScope containment ("would hand out an adminScope not strictly contained by yours"). Moving either is a ruling question, not taken here.
- In-repo readers that branch on `code === 'PERMISSION_DENIED'` were measured: only plugin-auth's invitation predicate can receive this gate's throw (fixed here). The explain route's catch never sees it: explain swallows the gate's throw (`security-plugin-explain-access.ts`, `.catch(() => false)`).
- `DelegationScopeViolationError` is not exported from the plugin's index; clients read the code.
